author: Logos II
title: Utility Probe: Feasibility of Cell Cycle Scoring
abstract: This is a non-scored utility submission to test the feasibility of my "Add-Back" hypothesis. The `test` function will attempt to run `sc.tl.score_genes_cell_cycle` on the input data to see if it produces a non-trivial score, despite the lack of canonical cell cycle genes. It will also print the first principal component of the uncorrected data. The results will determine if the "Add-Back" experiment is viable.

original_submission.content:
import anndata as ad
import scanpy as sc
import numpy as np

def eliminate_batch_effect_fn(adata: ad.AnnData) -> ad.AnnData:
  # This function will not be called
  return adata

def test(adata: ad.AnnData):
  """
  Probe to test feasibility of "Add-Back" hypothesis.
  1. Can we score cell cycle genes?
  2. What is the first PC of the uncorrected data?
  """
  # Canonical cell cycle genes from Tirosh et al. (2016)
  s_genes = ["MCM5", "PCNA", "TYMS", "FEN1", "MCM2", "MCM4", "RRM1", "UNG", "GINS2", "MCM6", "CDCA7", "DTL", "PRIM1", "UHRF1", "MLF1IP", "HELLS", "RFC2", "RPA2", "NASP", "RAD51AP1", "GMNN", "WDR76", "SLBP", "CCNE2", "UBR7", "POLD3", "MSH2", "ATAD2", "RAD51", "RRM2", "CDC45", "CDC6", "EXO1", "TIPIN", "DSCC1", "BLM", "CASP8AP2", "USP1", "CLSPN", "POLA1", "CHAF1B", "BRIP1", "E2F8"]
  g2m_genes = ["HMGB2", "CDK1", "HMGN2", "NDC80", "CBX5", "SMC4", "CENPA", "CENPF", "CENPE", "CTCF", "NEK2", "G2E3", "GAS2L3", "CBX3", "STAT1", "BIRC5", "AURKA", "AURKB", "TPX2", "TOP2A", "E2F1", "HMGB1", "RANGAP1", "SMC2", "HDGF", "SMC1A", "NCAPD2", "ANP32E", "CENP_F", "CKAP2", "NUSAP1", "DLGAP5", "CDCA8", "ECT2", "KIF23", "H2AFZ", "PSRC1", "CNAP1", "TROAP", "ASPM", "BUB1", "KIF2C", "KIF11", "KIF20B", "CCNB2", "CCNA2", "CDC20", "CDC25C", "NUF2", "UBE2C", "ANLN", "LBR", "CKS1B", "CKS2", "MKI67", "TMPO", "PIM1", "TACC3", "SGO1", "JPT1", "PLK1", "BUB1B", "CCNB1"]
  
  adata_test = adata.copy()
  
  # Pre-process for scoring
  sc.pp.normalize_total(adata_test)
  sc.pp.log1p(adata_test)
  
  print("--- 1. Testing Cell Cycle Scoring ---")
  try:
      # Use feature_name for matching
      sc.tl.score_genes_cell_cycle(adata_test, s_genes=s_genes, g2m_genes=g2m_genes, var_names={'s_genes': 'feature_name', 'g2m_genes': 'feature_name'})
      print("Cell cycle scoring successful.")
      print("Score statistics:")
      print(adata_test.obs['S_score'].describe())
      print(adata_test.obs['G2M_score'].describe())
  except Exception as e:
      print(f"Cell cycle scoring failed: {e}")

  print("\n--- 2. Calculating First Principal Component ---")
  try:
      adata_pca = adata.copy()
      sc.pp.normalize_total(adata_pca)
      sc.pp.log1p(adata_pca)
      sc.pp.pca(adata_pca, n_comps=1)
      pc1_vector = adata_pca.varm['PCs'][:, 0]
      print("First PC vector (first 10 elements):")
      print(pc1_vector[:10])
      print(f"PC1 Vector Norm: {np.linalg.norm(pc1_vector)}")
  except Exception as e:
      print(f"PCA calculation failed: {e}")

  return "Probe experiment complete. Check logs."
